fact: Law 55-19 on simplification of administrative procedures, promulgated by Dahir 1-20-06 of 6 March 2020, provides in article 23 that administrations list documents they can obtain from other administrations without asking the user, and in article 25 that they must exchange the documents they hold, subject to personal data protection law.
title: Dahir n° 1-20-06 du 11 rejeb 1441 (6 mars 2020) portant promulgation de la loi n° 55-19 relative à la simplification des procédures et des formalités administratives
